purpose: External donor intake for NK1: compare mechanisms, adapt selectively, and block unreviewed code or dependencies from being treated as production-ready.

codeAdoptionRequires: licenseAudit.status=complete with SPDX/compatible grant and reportPath
tests.status=complete with reproducible command and reportPath
explicit integration.mode=runtime-dependency only after all required gates pass
policy.evidenceRule: A repository description, star count, paper claim, local fixture, or file existence is not proof of NK1 runtime improvement.

donors.name: Hexis
donors.mechanism: belief provenance, typed long-term memory, goals, internal state and bounded autonomous cycle

integration.notes: Compare data contracts and evidence-backed belief revision; do not introduce a second identity or memory owner.

donors.nextGate: Inspect exact upstream revision, schema, real call path, license and tests; compare against current NK1 memory/identity contracts.

donors.name: Hermes Agent
donors.mechanism: tool contracts, reusable skills, error feedback, task execution and skill revision

integration.notes: NK1 already contains native Hermes-inspired mechanisms. This does not assert that upstream source files were copied or that the production end-to-end path is complete.

donors.nextGate: Trace production provider bootstrap through candidate execution, independent baseline/candidate evaluation, signed shadow evidence and explicit approval; verify upstream revision and license before any code port.

donors.name: Letta Code
donors.mechanism: persistent agent state, editable memory/skills, long-horizon continuity

integration.notes: Compare lifecycle and continuity patterns with the current runtime; do not add a second always-on agent harness.

donors.nextGate: Compare restart/recovery, skill mutation, memory versioning and approval boundaries against NK1.

donors.name: Cognee
donors.mechanism: knowledge extraction and graph-oriented retrieval over documents, conversations and code

integration.notes: Benchmark adapters/algorithms against the canonical memory owner before introducing a graph database or runtime dependency.

donors.nextGate: Run the same sanitized corpus and queries against NK1 baseline and a thin Cognee adapter; measure retrieval precision, recall, staleness and resource cost.

donors.name: Graphiti
donors.mechanism: time-aware facts, temporal relations and evidence-linked graph retrieval

integration.notes: Adapt temporal algorithms only if tests show value; avoid a second graph store unless measured scale requires it.

donors.nextGate: Test conflicting facts, event-time versus ingestion-time, stale-fact rejection and source lineage.

donors.name: Mem0
donors.mechanism: memory extraction, semantic/keyword retrieval and compact memory updates

integration.notes: Use as a comparative baseline, not as another concurrently authoritative memory store.

donors.nextGate: Establish a reproducible baseline on one corpus and identical query set; separate open SDK results from hosted-service claims.

donors.name: A-Mem / Agentic Memory
donors.mechanism: dynamic links and revision of older memory notes when new evidence arrives

integration.notes: Use the official paper record as a lead; locate and audit an accessible code revision before porting implementation.

donors.nextGate: Prototype link/update policy against fixed memory cases; test whether dynamic edits improve retrieval without corrupting provenance.

donors.name: Generative Agents
donors.mechanism: event memories, salience/retrieval, reflection and action planning

integration.notes: Use as a reference and scenario source, not as a parallel production agent.

donors.nextGate: Map each mechanism to an existing owner and build a small behavioral comparison with no new runtime dependency.

donors.name: Voyager
donors.mechanism: reusable executable skills, environment feedback, error-driven repair and transfer

integration.notes: Compare its skill search/repair loop with the existing versioned, verified NK1 skill lifecycle; do not bypass approval or holdout.

donors.nextGate: Measure reuse on unseen task variants, regression rate, rollback rate and cost per successful task.

donors.name: DSPy
donors.mechanism: metric-driven optimization of model programs using examples and feedback

integration.notes: Optimize offline on training/validation data only; keep an immutable untouched holdout and require rollback/regression checks.

donors.nextGate: First establish a metric and split protocol; prohibit holdout examples or verifier payload from the candidate generator.

donors.name: TinyTroupe
donors.mechanism: scenario simulation with differentiated synthetic persona attributes

integration.notes: Use for test scenario generation and behavior consistency probes; simulated users are not ground-truth evidence.

donors.nextGate: Review current project maturity/license, then use generated scenarios only with independently authored expected outcomes.

donors.name: LangGraph
donors.mechanism: explicit state machines, checkpoints, resume and human-in-the-loop flows

integration.notes: Alternative execution orchestration only; do not run alongside Hermes as a second execution authority.

donors.nextGate: Compare only if the native action/recovery flow fails a documented requirement.

donors.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
donors.mechanism: stateful workflows, transfers, multi-agent coordination and observability

integration.notes: Alternative to evaluate against the chosen executor; not a concurrent control plane.

donors.nextGate: Benchmark recovery, observability and required host integration only if a concrete gap remains.

donors.name: smolagents
donors.mechanism: compact tool-use/agent loop and code-action abstractions

integration.notes: Use as a complexity and action-loop baseline; production tools must still pass NK1 policy gates.

donors.nextGate: Compare on the same sandboxed task suite with tool safety, recovery, latency and cost metrics.

donors.name: OpenHands Software Agent SDK
donors.mechanism: isolated software workspaces, event streams, execution and software-agent APIs

integration.notes: Use only if NK1 lacks required engineering workspace features; not required in the cognitive kernel.

donors.nextGate: Review sandbox model, permissions, secret handling, license and tool boundary before any adapter.

donors.name: Avalanche
donors.mechanism: continual-learning strategies and forgetting/transfer evaluation for PyTorch

integration.notes: Keep neural weight/adaptor training separate from L1 memory and L2 skill/procedure learning.

donors.nextGate: Prototype replay/regularization baselines offline; measure forgetting, transfer, compute and compatibility.

donors.name: The AI Scientist
donors.mechanism: hypothesis generation, experiment execution and report-based evaluation

integration.notes: Use for controlled research orchestration only; generated code runs in an external sandbox and never directly updates production state.

donors.nextGate: Read the exact Responsible AI License and model/data terms; prove code isolation before experimenting.

donors.name: OpenCog Hyperon
donors.mechanism: symbolic representations, MeTTa and inspectable rule-based inference

integration.notes: Evaluate a narrow inference task before considering a second knowledge representation at runtime.

donors.nextGate: Test contradiction detection and bounded inference against explicit expected results.

donors.name: Continuous Thought Machines
donors.mechanism: temporal dynamics and synchronization inside a recurrent neural architecture

integration.notes: Separate research on model architecture from cognitive algorithms implemented around the current language model.

donors.nextGate: Defer until a reproducible baseline, suitable hardware budget and task-specific acceptance criteria exist.

donors.name: RWKV-LM
donors.mechanism: recurrent/linear-time language model families

integration.notes: Model-provider comparison only; weights and runtime architectures are not drop-in code modules.

donors.nextGate: Compare compatible quantized model checkpoints on the same memory/planning/tool-use suite and record model/license terms.

donors.name: Mamba
donors.mechanism: selective state-space models for sequence processing

integration.notes: Treat as a base-model research track, not a plug-in to Hermes or the memory system.

donors.nextGate: Check kernels, hardware requirements, checkpoint license and inference performance before any implementation.

donors.name: Qwen-Agent
donors.mechanism: tool calling, MCP/RAG and Qwen ecosystem adapters

integration.notes: Compare provider/tool adapters only if NK1's existing provider contracts leave a concrete compatibility gap.

donors.nextGate: Test model-initiated tool-call correctness and failure handling; do not transfer incompatible model weights.

donors.name: LongMemEval
donors.mechanism: long-term conversational memory evaluation

integration.notes: Adapt the official protocol transparently and keep a versioned untouched holdout.

donors.nextGate: Inspect data license, official scoring, contamination/leakage constraints and the feasibility of running the benchmark.

donors.name: LoCoMo
donors.mechanism: long conversations, temporal and multi-session memory evaluation

integration.notes: Keep official results separate from any NK1-specific changes to prompt, dataset or scoring.

donors.nextGate: Pin dataset/code revisions, validate licensing and add a documented NK1 adapter without modifying canonical samples.

donors.name: Mem2ActBench
donors.mechanism: checking whether remembered preferences/state ground subsequent tool choice and parameters

integration.notes: High-value gap test: measure whether recalled data actually changes a correct action rather than only improving text recall.

donors.nextGate: Locate official code/data and license, then define a fixed memory-to-action suite with action correctness as the outcome.

donors.name: SWE-bench
donors.mechanism: repository-grounded software bug-fix tasks and test-based outcome verification

integration.notes: Use only for evaluating the engineering executor; report task subset, instance count, environment and hidden-test caveats.

donors.nextGate: Pin exact benchmark split and environment; ensure candidate code is isolated and evaluation cannot see hidden tests.

donors.name: SWE-agent
donors.mechanism: repository navigation, edit/test cycles and software-agent interaction design

integration.notes: Compare execution workflow patterns; avoid adding a second engineer agent if current gateway can support the required tasks.

donors.nextGate: Evaluate on a narrow reproducible set with the same tools, sandbox and time limits.
